comparisonUse: Used only to check correspondence, not included in Amudi. After removing markup and non-Hebrew characters, the whole comparison section occurs inside the retained numbered Hebrew block.
limitations: Source-provided license labels are evidence, not independent certification. This checks Hebrew placement, not English translation quality. Blocks may contain other untranslated sections; section 32 source translation begins mid-section. Variant matches are not character-for-character identical; differences and translation quality are not independently adjudicated. Source paragraph correspondence and Hebrew similarity do not independently certify translation quality. Section 156 contains only one English paragraph.

variantMethod: Compared each explicit numbered Hebrew dialogue section with the same numbered provider Hebrew section, ignoring markup and non-Hebrew characters. Similarities >= 0.975 are recorded as variants; two cross-block sections were excluded.
splitSectionMethod: Source Hebrew and English paragraph counts match. Numbered sections 36 and 40 are divided at the same source paragraph boundaries as the local Hebrew blocks; each Hebrew portion has at least 0.995 normalized similarity.

additionalPartialMatch.limitation: The English source provides only paragraph 2 of this section; the Hebrew reading block contains many other untranslated sections.
